blocking_findings.risk: A worker can choose PASS and recompute a valid payload hash if validation never re-derives outcome.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: The trusted builder excludes computed fields and validation mechanically re-derives outcome from requirements, receipts, ticket state, scope delta, and side effects.
blocking_findings.test: A PASS report with a failing required receipt is rejected even after rehashing.

blocking_findings.risk: A permissive V1 normalization path can turn a tampered legacy report into apparently valid V2 evidence.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Use one exact-byte-hash adoption adapter and preserve the legacy source outcome without promotion.
blocking_findings.test: A one-byte V1 mutation fails adoption before V2 construction.

non_blocking_findings.risk: Usage parsing can coerce null UNKNOWN values to numeric zero.
non_blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Enforce nullable numeric fields and closed usage status without coercion.
non_blocking_findings.test: UNKNOWN usage requires null numeric values.

non_blocking_findings.risk: An empty changed_files array is not proof that the baseline had no change.
non_blocking_findings.minimal_fix: The trusted builder must derive file deltas from the bound baseline rather than trust a worker assertion.
non_blocking_findings.test: A baseline mismatch cannot be hidden by an empty changed_files list.

recommended_next_three_tests: Exact-byte legacy adoption followed by strict V2 validation.
Mechanical outcome re-derivation rejects a caller-selected PASS.
UNKNOWN external usage remains null and cannot be post-filled to force PASS.
avoid_building: A random or time-dependent outcome derivation.
A lenient JSON parser that coerces null values.
